newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen easier on property concerns.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen easier on property concerns.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to open easier on Thursday following weakness in London and on concerns about government measures to curb property prices, brokers said.
"The market tone turned slightly weak and the Hang Seng Index is likely to fall by about 100 points today," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
On Wednesday, the Hang Seng Index fell 18.19 points to 14,421.52. Later, the Hong Kong London Reference Index of Hong Kong shares traded in London fell 84.88 points to 14,336.64.
